units.title: 可、将、搞
units.intro: HSK 5, words 1–41, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: (prefix) can; may; able to; -able; to approve; to permit; to suit

ex.zh: 不好意思，请问我可以开窗吗？
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ kāi chuāng ma
ex.en: Excuse me, may I open the window?

ex.zh: 今天没有任何下雨的可能性。
ex.p: jīn tiān méi yǒu rèn hé xià yǔ de kě néng xìng
ex.en: There's no chance of rain today.

ex.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
ex.p: hěn nán shuō míng tiān de tiān qì jiāng huì zěn yàng
ex.en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.

ex.zh: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
ex.p: xià yī cháng yīn yuè huì jiāng zài liù yuè fèn jǔ bàn
ex.en: The next concert will take place in June.

items.en: to do; to make; to go in for

ex.zh: 无论怎么去想我都搞不清楚。
ex.p: wú lùn zěn me qù xiǎng wǒ dōu gǎo bù qīng chu
ex.en: No matter how much I think about it, I can't understand it.

ex.zh: 他终于弄清楚怎么搞定这事了。
ex.p: tā zhōng yú lòng qīng chu zěn me gǎo dìng zhè shì le
ex.en: He finally found out how to make it.

ex.zh: 他是村子里面唯一在世的人。
ex.p: tā shì cūn zǐ lǐ miàn wéi yī zài shì de rén
ex.en: He's the only survivor in the village.

ex.zh: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。
ex.p: rén shì wéi yī huì shǐ yòng huǒ de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.

ex.zh: 人生就是如此。
ex.p: rén shēng jiù shì rú cǐ
ex.en: That's life.

ex.zh: 我如此想念你。
ex.p: wǒ rú cǐ xiǎng niàn nǐ
ex.en: I miss you so much.

items.en: to be certain; to be positive; assuredly

ex.zh: 他还没来。他肯定错过公交车了。
ex.p: tā hái méi lái tā kěn dìng cuò guò gōng jiāo chē le
ex.en: He hasn't come yet. He must have missed the bus.

ex.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。
ex.p: tā kě néng shì hù shi wǒ bù tài kěn dìng
ex.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.

ex.zh: 我不太喜欢他，其实我讨厌他。
ex.p: wǒ bù tài xǐ huan tā qí shí wǒ tǎo yàn tā
ex.en: I don't really like him, in fact, I hate him.

ex.zh: 我没有其他更好的事情去做。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu qí tā gēng hǎo de shì qing qù zuò
ex.en: I have nothing better to do.

items.en: to kill; to murder; to attack

ex.zh: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。
ex.p: zhè jiù shì nà gè zuò jiā zì shā de fáng jiān
ex.en: This is the room where the author killed himself.

ex.zh: 我会不高兴，但我不会自杀。
ex.p: wǒ huì bù gāo xìng dàn wǒ bù huì zì shā
ex.en: I'd be unhappy, but I wouldn't kill myself.

ex.zh: 在他们控制我们之前，我们先制服他们。
ex.p: zài tā men kòng zhì wǒ men zhī qián wǒ men xiān zhì fú tā men
ex.en: Get them before they get us.

ex.zh: 我失去了控制。
ex.p: wǒ shī qù le kòng zhì
ex.en: I'm losing my grip.

ex.zh: 你能大声点讲吗？我听不太清。
ex.p: nǐ néng dà shēng diǎn jiǎng ma wǒ yǐn bù tài qīng
ex.en: Could you please talk a bit louder? I can't hear very well.

ex.zh: 您能把收音机开小声一点吗？
ex.p: nín néng bǎ shōu yīn jī kāi xiǎo shēng yī diǎn ma
ex.en: Could you turn down the radio?

ex.zh: 谁组织了这次会议？
ex.p: shéi zǔ zhī le zhè cì huì yì
ex.en: Who organized that meeting?

ex.zh: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
ex.p: tā zài jiāo xué shǎng yōng yǒu fēng fù de jīng yàn
ex.en: He has a lot of teaching experience.

ex.zh: 他拥有的书是我拥有的三倍。
ex.p: tā yōng yǒu de shū shì wǒ yōng yǒu de sān bèi
ex.en: He has three times as many books as I have.

ex.zh: 一场令人难忘的事件发生了。
ex.p: yī cháng líng rén nán wàng de shì jiàn fā shēng le
ex.en: An unforgettable event occurred.

ex.zh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
ex.p: tā mìng lìng wǒ lì kè lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān
ex.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.

ex.zh: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。
ex.p: yī bēi lěng shuǐ zài shǔ rè de tiān qì lǐ shí fēn dī shén
ex.en: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.

ex.zh: 我是无神论者。
ex.p: wǒ shì wú shén lùn zhě
ex.en: I'm an atheist.

ex.zh: 他给父母写信至少一周一次。
ex.p: tā gěi fù mǔ xiě xìn zhì shǎo yī zhōu yī cì
ex.en: She wrote to her parents at least once a week.

ex.zh: 这部电影至少值得看两三遍。
ex.p: zhè bù diàn yǐng zhì shǎo zhí de kàn liǎng sān biàn
ex.en: The movie is worth seeing at least two or three times.

items.en: one more time; again; one more

ex.zh: 我们很高兴再次见到你。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng zài cì jiàn dào nǐ
ex.en: We are happy to see you again.

ex.zh: 他再次被选为市长。
ex.p: tā zài cì bèi xuǎn wèi shì zhǎng
ex.en: He was re-elected mayor.

items.en: to renounce; to abandon; to give up

ex.zh: 我说服他放弃了这个主意。
ex.p: wǒ shuō fú tā fàng qì le zhè gè zhǔ yi
ex.en: I talked him out of the idea.

ex.zh: 她不得不放弃这个计划。
ex.p: tā bù dé bù fàng qì zhè gè jì huà
ex.en: She was obliged to give up the plan.

ex.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
ex.p: tā men fēn fáng shuì jí shǐ tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le
ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.

ex.zh: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。
ex.p: jí shǐ wǒ zhī dào dá àn wǒ yě bù huì gào sù nǐ
ex.en: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.

ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn xià zhe yǔ tā hái shi chū qù le
ex.en: He went out in spite of the rain.

ex.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn lěng hái zi què méi yǒu dà yī chuān
ex.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

items.en: second (unit of time); arc second (angular measurement unit); (coll.) instantly
to accompany; to keep sb company; to assist

ex.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
ex.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
ex.en: I really enjoy your company.

ex.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
ex.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
ex.en: You've got company.

items.en: unexpectedly; to one's surprise; go so far as to

ex.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
ex.p: wǒ réng jiù wú fǎ xiāng xìn wǒ jū rán zuò le zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I still can't believe I did it.

ex.zh: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。
ex.p: ràng wǒ chū hū yì liào de shì tā jū rán hěn huì chàng gē
ex.en: To my surprise, he was good at singing.

ex.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
ex.p: yín háng duì fēng xiǎn kè hù shōu qǔ jiào gāo de dài kuǎn lì xī
ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.

ex.zh: 我们已经将它做了分析。
ex.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng jiāng tā zuò le fēn xī
ex.en: We've had it analyzed.

items.en: to enjoy; to live it up; pleasure

ex.zh: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu hé nǐ de liáo tiān
ex.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

ex.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
ex.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

ex.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
ex.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
ex.en: That's the point.

ex.zh: 这是一个关键点。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
ex.en: This is a crucial point.

ex.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
ex.p: dà jiā dōu kě wàng zhī dào qián guàn jūn de zhǔ fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.

ex.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。
ex.p: wèi qiǎng jiù bìng rén yī shēng yǐ jìn lì le
ex.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.

ex.zh: 我来问个有点傻的问题。
ex.p: wǒ lái wèn gè yǒu diǎn shǎ de wèn tí
ex.en: Let me ask a stupid question.

ex.zh: 我不像你想的那么傻。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng nǐ xiǎng de nà me shǎ
ex.en: I'm not as stupid as you think I am.

ex.zh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。
ex.p: tā qù hé tā de biǎo dì dāi zài yī qǐ le
ex.en: He went to stay with his cousin.

ex.zh: 他迫不及待地想要知道结果。
ex.p: tā pò bù jí dài de xiǎng yào zhī dào jiē guǒ
ex.en: He is anxious to know the result.

items.en: to reinstate; to resume; to restore

ex.zh: 他从重感冒中恢复了过来。
ex.p: tā cóng zhòng gǎn mào zhōng huī fù le guò lái
ex.en: He has recovered from his bad cold.

ex.zh: 他既不喜欢棒球，又不喜欢足球。
ex.p: tā jì bù xǐ huan bàng qiú yòu bù xǐ huan zú qiú
ex.en: He likes neither baseball nor football.

ex.zh: 他既会打网球，又会打棒球。
ex.p: tā jì huì dá wǎng qiú yòu huì dá bàng qiú
ex.en: He can play both tennis and baseball.

ex.zh: 不是每个人都意识到这点。
ex.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu yì shí dào zhè diǎn
ex.en: Not everyone noticed.

ex.zh: 他已经意识到它了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng yì shí dào tā le
ex.en: He already knew about it.

items.en: in case (sth happens); if; once (sth happens, then...)

ex.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
ex.p: huài xí guàn yī dàn bèi yǎng chéng biàn bù néng jiǎn dān de gǎi zhèng
ex.en: Once you've formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.

items.en: to implement; to carry out; to execute

ex.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū zhí xíng tā de mìng lìng
ex.en: We must execute his orders.

ex.zh: 缓期执行在最后关头决定了下来。
ex.p: huǎn qī zhí xíng zài zuì hòu guān tóu jué dìng le xià lai
ex.en: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.

items.en: to share (let others have some of sth good)

ex.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shǎng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
ex.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

ex.zh: 参与者大部分是女性。
ex.p: cān yù zhě dà bù fen shì nǚ xìng
ex.en: The participants were for the most part women.

items.en: classifier for small spheres, pearls, corn grains, teeth, hearts, satellites etc

ex.zh: 我想要一颗糖。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī kē táng
ex.en: I want a piece of candy.

ex.zh: 我很讨厌有女的说：“男人都一样”。
ex.p: wǒ hěn tǎo yàn yǒu nǚ de shuō nán rén dōu yī yàng
ex.en: I hate it when women say that all men are the same.

ex.zh: 我讨厌在情人节一人独处。
ex.p: wǒ tǎo yàn zài qíng rén jiē yī rén dú chù
ex.en: I hate being alone on Valentine's Day.

ex.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
ex.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

ex.zh: 我的一位朋友被枪杀。
ex.p: wǒ de yī wèi péng you bèi qiāng shā
ex.en: My friend was shot.

units.title: 拒绝、疯、式
units.intro: HSK 5, words 42–82, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to refuse; to decline; to reject

ex.zh: 我拒绝被像一个孩子般对待。
ex.p: wǒ jù jué bèi xiàng yī gè hái zi bān duì dài
ex.en: I refuse to be treated like a child.

ex.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
ex.p: yī shēng men jù jué zuò dì èr cì shǒu shù
ex.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

ex.zh: 一时间我还以为他疯了。
ex.p: yī shí jiān wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā fēng le
ex.en: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.

ex.zh: 他因为没有被邀请而气得快疯了。
ex.p: tā yīn wèi méi yǒu bèi yāo qǐng ér qì de kuài fēng le
ex.en: He was mad because he was not invited.

ex.zh: 我记得你以前跳舞的方式。
ex.p: wǒ jì de nǐ yǐ qián tiào wǔ de fāng shì
ex.en: I remember the way you used to dance.

ex.zh: 笔记本电脑比台式电脑好。
ex.p: bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo bǐ tái shì diàn nǎo hǎo
ex.en: A laptop is better than a desktop.

ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就呆在家。
ex.p: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù dāi zài jiā
ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.

ex.zh: 我不得不一整天都呆在床上。
ex.p: wǒ bù dé bù yī zhěng tiān dōu dāi zài chuáng shǎng
ex.en: I had to stay in bed all day.

items.en: disembodied spirit; ghost; devil; sly; crafty; resourceful (variant of 诡)

ex.zh: 据说这房子是个鬼屋。
ex.p: jù shuō zhè fáng zi shì gè guǐ wū
ex.en: It is said the house is haunted.

ex.zh: 你相信鬼存在吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiāng xìn guǐ cún zài ma
ex.en: Do you believe in ghosts?

items.en: a register; block of printing; edition

ex.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
ex.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.

ex.zh: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
ex.p: wǒ yǐn guò zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn
ex.en: I heard the song sung in French.

items.en: to estimate; to reckon; (coll.) to suppose

ex.zh: 我估计我无法及时赶到。
ex.p: wǒ gū jì wǒ wú fǎ jí shí gǎn dào
ex.en: I don't think I'll be able to get there on time.

ex.zh: 估计那就是个笑话吧。
ex.p: gū jì nà jiù shì gè xiào hua ba
ex.en: I guess it's only a joke.

items.en: to signify; to mean; to imply

ex.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
ex.p: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng
ex.en: This probably means war.

ex.zh: 沉默就意味着同意。
ex.p: chén mò jiù yì wèi zhe tóng yì
ex.en: Silence gives consent.

ex.zh: 我不是这个俱乐部的会员。
ex.p: wǒ bù shì zhè gè jù lè bù de huì yuán
ex.en: I'm not a member of the club.

ex.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
ex.p: tā shòu yāo zuò jù lè bù de zhǔ xí
ex.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.

items.en: inside; among; in the midst of (doing sth)

ex.zh: 一年之中，你最喜欢哪个季节？
ex.p: yī nián zhī zhōng nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié
ex.en: What's your favorite season of the year?

ex.zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
ex.p: wǒ hài pà yī gè rén chǔ zài hēi àn zhī zhōng
ex.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.

ex.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
ex.p: zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
ex.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

items.en: to reveal; to display; to show; to exhibit

items.en: to esteem; to respect; to honor

ex.zh: 谢谢您答应到来。

ex.p: bù yào chā shǒu wǒ de sī shēng huó

exercises.p: wǒ men jǐ jìn le nà jiān xiǎo fáng jiān lǐ

exercises.zh: 你知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿吗？
exercises.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me jià shǐ zhè wán yìr ma

exercises.p: wǒ mèi mei zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn

units.title: 偶像、挡、届
units.intro: HSK 5, words 247–287, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to resist; to obstruct; to hinder

ex.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
ex.p: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.

ex.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
ex.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
ex.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

items.en: to arrive at (place or time); period; to become due
to taste; to try (food); to experience; (literary) ever; once

ex.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

ex.zh: 她总是尝试新事物。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì cháng shì xīn shì wù
ex.en: She is always trying new things.

items.en: to recognize; to know; to admit

ex.zh: 他不认识我们中的任何一个。
ex.p: tā bù rèn shi wǒ men zhōng de rèn hé yī gè
ex.en: He doesn't know any of us.

ex.zh: 几乎没有人认为我们是姐妹。
ex.p: jī hū méi yǒu rén rèn wéi wǒ men shì jiě mèi
ex.en: Almost nobody thinks we're sisters.

items.en: conflict; to conflict; clash of opposing forces
to be present; to be on the scene

ex.zh: 不要对批评太敏感了。
ex.p: bù yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le
ex.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

ex.zh: 猫的眼睛对光很敏感。
ex.p: māo de yǎn jing duì guāng hěn mǐn gǎn
ex.en: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.

ex.zh: 这只猫不抓老鼠。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ māo bù zhuā lǎo shǔ
ex.en: This cat doesn't chase mice.

ex.zh: 猫抓住了老鼠。
ex.p: māo zhuā zhù le lǎo shǔ
ex.en: The cat caught a mouse.

items.en: to point out; to remind (sb of sth); to suggest

ex.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yī gè tí shì ma
ex.en: Would you give me a hint?

ex.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
ex.p: diàn huà yùn yíng shāng tí shì lái diàn rén děng hòu jiē tōng
ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

items.en: to throw down; to fall; to drop and break

ex.zh: 你摔坏过你的眼镜吗？
ex.p: nǐ shuāi huài guò nǐ de yǎn jìng ma
ex.en: Have you ever broken your glasses?

ex.zh: 她从梯子上摔了下来。
ex.p: tā cóng tī zi shǎng shuāi le xià lai
ex.en: She fell down the ladder.

items.en: to join; to connect; to link up; to communicate
to put in order; to tidy up; to pack

ex.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
ex.p: tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shi zhuō zi
ex.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

ex.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
ex.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

items.en: only if (..., or otherwise, ...); only when; only in the case that

ex.zh: 除非雨停了，我们才会出去。
ex.p: chú fēi yǔ tíng le wǒ men cái huì chū qù
ex.en: We won't go out unless it stops raining.

ex.zh: 有些乘客抱怨服务态度不好。
ex.p: yǒu xiē chéng kè bào yuàn fú wù tài du bù hǎo
ex.en: Some passengers complained about the service.

ex.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
ex.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

ex.zh: 我想让她干这项艰难的工作。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng ràng tā gàn zhè xiàng jiān nán de gōng zuò
ex.en: I want to leave this difficult job to her.

ex.zh: 养大一个宝宝是一项艰难的工作。
ex.p: yǎng dà yī gè bǎo bao shì yī xiàng jiān nán de gōng zuò
ex.en: Bringing up a baby is hard work.

ex.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
ex.p: nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
ex.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.

ex.zh: 汤姆买了新专辑。
ex.p: tāng mǔ mǎi le xīn zhuān jí
ex.en: Tom bought the new album.

ex.zh: 老虎吃什么东西？
ex.p: lǎo hǔ chī shén me dōng xī
ex.en: What do tigers eat?

ex.zh: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。
ex.p: shān shǎng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zǐ chèn dà wáng
ex.en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

items.en: to wind; to coil (thread); to rotate around

ex.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
ex.p: ràng wèi xīng huán rào dì qiú de shì zhòng lì
ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.

items.en: to puff; to spout; to spray

ex.zh: 火山突然喷发，造成了多人死亡。
ex.p: huǒ shān tū rán pēn fā zào chéng le duō rén sǐ wáng
ex.en: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.

items.en: to complain; to grumble; to harbor a complaint

ex.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。
ex.p: tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn zhǐ shì zài bào yuàn
ex.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.

ex.zh: 我不想再听你抱怨了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài yǐn nǐ bào yuàn le
ex.en: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.

ex.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
ex.p: yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng
ex.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

items.en: to set about (a task); to hit; to punch

ex.zh: 医生决定立刻动手术。
ex.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
ex.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

items.en: to be close to; to approach; to draw near

ex.zh: 把椅子挪一挪靠近桌子。
ex.p: bǎ yǐ zi nuó yī nuó kào jìn zhuō zi
ex.en: Move the chair nearer to the desk.

ex.zh: 我和我的邻居关系很好。
ex.p: wǒ hé wǒ de lín jū guān xi hěn hǎo
ex.en: I'm on good terms with the neighbors.

ex.zh: 我们是隔着墙的邻居。
ex.p: wǒ men shì gé zhe qiáng de lín jū
ex.en: We're next-door neighbors.

items.en: to pollute; to contaminate (lit. and fig.)

ex.zh: 我们有一节关于环境污染的讲座。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu yī jiē guān yú huán jìng wū rǎn de jiǎng zuò
ex.en: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.

ex.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
ex.p: zhè cháng tán lùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn
ex.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

ex.zh: 您为什么惩罚他们？
ex.p: nín wèi shén me chéng fá tā men
ex.en: What are you punishing them for?

ex.zh: 现在是买它的最好时机。
ex.p: xiàn zài shì mǎi tā de zuì hǎo shí jī
ex.en: Now is a great time to buy one of those.

items.en: too bad; how terrible; what bad luck

ex.zh: 我还没觉得有那么糟糕。
ex.p: wǒ hái méi jué de yǒu nà me zāo gāo
ex.en: I didn't think it was so bad.

ex.zh: 一切都很糟糕。
ex.p: yī qiè dōu hěn zāo gāo
ex.en: Everything is bad.

items.en: in the sky; in the air

ex.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
ex.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
ex.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

ex.zh: 天空中繁星点点。
ex.p: tiān kōng zhōng fán xīng diǎn diǎn
ex.en: The sky is full of stars.

items.en: to thirst for; to long for

ex.zh: 他渴望去那里。
ex.p: tā kě wàng qù nà li
ex.en: He is eager to go there.

items.en: to link; to join; to connect
to tear open; to tear down; to tear apart

ex.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén huì wèi zhè gè jiù jiàn zhù wù de chāi chú ér là lèi
ex.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.

ex.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
ex.p: cóng tiān shàng kàn xià lai zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé
ex.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

ex.zh: 我们用耳朵听。
ex.p: wǒ men yòng ěr duo yǐn
ex.en: We hear with our ears.

ex.zh: 他说的时候，我脑中浮现出了画面。
ex.p: tā shuō de shí hou wǒ nǎo zhōng fú xiàn chū le huà miàn
ex.en: As he spoke, pictures came into my mind.

ex.zh: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ wèi nǐ diào bēi rè yǐn liào ma
ex.en: Can I fix you a hot drink?

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de yǐn liào shì shén me
ex.en: What's your favorite drink?

units.title: 扮演、大脑、鼻子
units.intro: HSK 5, words 288–328, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to play the role of; to act

ex.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
ex.p: dà zì rán zài wǒ men de shēng huó zhōng bàn yǎn zhuó zhòng yào de jué sè
ex.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.

ex.zh: 我的鼻子没办法呼吸了。
ex.p: wǒ de bí zi méi bàn fǎ hū xī le
ex.en: I can't breathe through my nose.

ex.zh: 她把鼻子贴在玻璃上。
ex.p: tā bǎ bí zi tiē zài bō li shǎng
ex.en: She pressed her nose against the glass.

ex.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
ex.p: tā yǒu chāo guò yī bǎi mò měi yuán de zī chǎn
ex.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.

items.en: major event; major political event (war or change of regime)

ex.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。
ex.p: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì
ex.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

items.en: (fig.) to function; to be in operation

ex.zh: 系统运行起来了。
ex.p: xì tǒng yùn xíng qǐ lai le
ex.en: The system worked.

items.en: to have expectations; to earnestly hope; expectation

ex.zh: 我没有期望得到这样的结果。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu qī wàng dé dào zhè yàng de jiē guǒ
ex.en: I didn't expect that result.

ex.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
ex.p: wǒ bù qī wàng tā men néng gòu zhī chí wǒ de guān diǎn
ex.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.

items.en: to make visible; to reveal; prominent

ex.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào xiǎn wēi jìng hé wàng yuǎn jìng de chā bié ma
ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

ex.zh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
ex.p: nà fáng zi yīn wèi qí shǎo yǒu de xíng zhuàng bèi tū xiǎn chū lái
ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.

ex.zh: 你们很容易就能看出区别。
ex.p: nǐ men hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

ex.zh: 您很容易就能看出区别。
ex.p: nín hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

ex.zh: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yán sù de tán lùn nǐ de wèi lái
ex.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.

ex.zh: 我们认为这不严肃。
ex.p: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè bù yán sù
ex.en: We don't think it's serious.

ex.zh: 游泳锻炼肌肉。
ex.p: yóu yǒng duàn liàn jī ròu
ex.en: Swimming develops your muscles.

ex.zh: 很多人在随后的爆炸中死去。
ex.p: hěn duō rén zài suí hòu de bào zhà zhōng sǐ qù
ex.en: The explosion that followed killed many people.

ex.zh: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me lái ān wèi nǐ
ex.en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

ex.zh: 我可以安慰她。
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ ān wèi tā
ex.en: I can comfort her.

items.en: year (e.g. school year, fiscal year); annual
to lift; to raise; (of two or more persons) to carry

ex.zh: 警察小心翼翼地抬起箱子。
ex.p: jǐng chá xiǎo xīn yì yì de tái qǐ xiāng zi
ex.en: The policeman lifted the box carefully.

items.en: to inspect; to examine; to test
to eliminate; to remove; to exclude
to publish; to issue (stocks, currency etc); to release

ex.zh: 我为这家报社工作四年了。
ex.p: wǒ wèi zhè jiā bào shè gōng zuò sì nián le
ex.en: I've been working for this newspaper for four years.

ex.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。
ex.p: měi guó shì yī gè zì chēng méi yǒu shè huì jiē céng de guó jiā
ex.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.

ex.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù
ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

ex.zh: 汤姆拥抱了他的父亲。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yōng bào le tā de fù qīn
ex.en: Tom hugged his father.

ex.zh: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。
ex.p: xiāo fáng chē dào dá zhī qián fáng zi jiù quán shāo le
ex.en: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.

ex.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
ex.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shǎng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

items.en: to press from either side; to place in between; to sandwich

ex.zh: 好痛！被门夹到手指了！
ex.p: hǎo tòng bèi mén jiā dào shǒu zhǐ le
ex.en: Ouch! My finger got caught in the door.

ex.zh: 我的手被门夹到了。
ex.p: wǒ de shǒu bèi mén jiā dào le
ex.en: I caught my finger in the door.

items.en: to point out; to indicate; to instruct

ex.zh: 我只是照著你的指示。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì zhào zhù nǐ de zhǐ shì
ex.en: I just followed your instructions.

ex.zh: 我会听从指示。
ex.p: wǒ huì tīng cóng zhǐ shì
ex.en: I will obey.

ex.zh: 自己说过的话都不记得了吗？
ex.p: zì jǐ shuō guò de huà dōu bù jì de le ma
